senses.definition: Worthy or suitable for collecting on historical/financial grounds, or for meeting a personal aesthetic.
examples: collectible stamps, collectible china, collectible Beatles memorabilia

quotes.text: With the lifting of his “depression,” he’d developed a new interest, hobbylike in its intensity, in framable and collectible railroad memorabilia, and he could happily have spent the whole day—the whole week!—pursuing it. . .

senses.definition: That is likely to be paid.
examples: He's owed it to us for six months, but it doesn't look very collectible to me.

senses.definition: An object which someone might want to collect.

quotes.text: Topps[…] has signed the Clique Girlz as commercial spokeswomen for Baby Bottle Pop, one of the Top 10 nonchocolate candy brands.
